documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust pre-sales growth and expanding profitability. Pre-sales for H1 FY27 reached INR879 crores, while total revenue and EBITDA experienced substantial year-on-year increases. The company added three new projects during the quarter, bringing its total pipeline to 24 projects, and reaffirmed its full-year guidance for pre-sales, revenue, and margins. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, driven by strong pre-sales growth across its luxury and ultra-luxury residential and commercial portfolio in Mumbai. Management expressed confidence in meeting its full-year FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR 1,800-2,000 crores and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident in delivering its FY27 pre-sales guidance ranging from INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: EBITDA and PAT margins are expected to remain at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of delivering stated guidance for FY27 of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: Management remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

demand_outlook.claim: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, led by the luxury segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year in the first half of the calendar year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the calendar year, sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores, while prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year, more than twice the global average.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is largely driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not expect the recent repo rate hike by the RBI to materially alter demand in the luxury micromarkets they operate in.
demand_outlook.quote: Our buyers rely far less on home loans and buy for long-term value and lifestyle. We, therefore, do not expect it to materially alter demand in the micromarkets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: There is strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, alongside high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%.
demand_outlook.quote: While most buyers globally are being cautious, given interest rates and broader uncertainty, luxury buyers are not. They are driven by long-term wealth creation, family legacy, and lifestyle, not by loan rates.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

demand_outlook.claim: Price rises of about 5% to 10% have been observed in the operating micro-markets.
demand_outlook.quote: So, as far as price rise is concerned, it's about 5% to 10% we have seen the price rise.

demand_outlook.claim: The company achieves pricing in its micro-market that is 10% to 15% higher than other developers.
demand_outlook.quote: So, regarding the pricing related to other developers, so normally in our micro-market we are getting 10% to 15% higher than the other developers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added three new projects during the quarter: Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.
capex_expansion.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four projects in the second half of the year: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The flagship ultra-luxury mixed-use project in GIFT City Area has an expected commencement in Q1 FY28 and completion timeline of FY31.
capex_expansion.quote:
Completion Timeline: FY31
❖ Expected Commencement: Q1 FY28

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project in Juhu with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores with margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: For H1 FY27, EBITDA stood at INR155 crores, up 95%, with a margin of 38.80%.
margins_costs.quote: Total revenue grew 69% to INR401 crores, EBITDA increased 95% to INR155 crores, with a healthy margin of 38.80%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for H1 FY27 stood at INR134 crores, up 86%, at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: The company maintains a consistent PAT margin of approximately 25%-30% on a consistent basis.
margins_costs.quote:
PAT Margin (%)
~ 25%-30%
on a consistent basis

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 stood at INR48 crores with an EBITDA margin of 36.4%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 FY27 pre-sales were recorded at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Delighted to share that we recorded pre-sales for the quarter at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for H1 FY27 stood at INR879 crores, up 176% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR879 crores, up 176% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident in Andheri West contributed pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since launch.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident in Andheri West, our luxury commercial offering, has been a standout performer, contributing pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since its launch at the end of June.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, and for H1 FY27 pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs. For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: Total project surplus from ongoing, completed, and upcoming projects is approximately INR 9,500 Crs based on management estimates.
orders_capacity.quote:
Project Surplus^
9,500
~INR Crs.
From ongoing + Completed+ Upcoming Projects

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores for Q1 FY27, up 567% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales stood at INR409 crores, up by 567% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores, of which 17 are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores. Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of the portfolio.
capital_allocation.quote: In addition, our estimated project-level surplus stands at approximately INR9,500 crores over the development cycle of our portfolio.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of its IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the IPO proceeds, INR305 crores had been deployed as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026. We remain on track with our planned utilization schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: Proceeds from the IPO fresh issue of INR 792 Crs are deployed towards part-funding development and construction costs of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun, and general corporate requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, total cash balance was approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun from IPO proceeds, INR271 crores has been deployed as on 30th June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

risks_headwinds.claim: The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, which is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to complete the current portfolio of projects over the next four to four and a half years.
management_commitments.quote: And our intention to complete these projects for next four, four and a half years. So, you can calculate that.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve its full-year guidance for FY27 of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
management_commitments.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects all approvals for the Gift City project to be in place by the end of the year and to start the project immediately thereafter.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting that by the end of this year, we'll get all our approvals in place. Immediately after that, we will be starting the project.

management_commitments.claim: The Juhu commercial redevelopment project will take about 3 to 4 years to complete after starting next year.
management_commitments.quote: And hopefully, we will be starting this project next year, after passing of plans, and other formalities. Will take about 3 to 4 years thereafter to complete the project.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
